words.English Meaning: to look / to watch / to read
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我看了一本很有意思的书。(Wǒ kàn le yì běn hěn yǒuyìsi de shū.) — I read an interesting book.
我喜欢听中国流行音乐。(Wǒ xǐhuan tīng Zhōngguó liúxíng yīnyuè.) — I like listening to Chinese pop music.
请说得慢一点儿。(Qǐng shuō de màn yìdiǎnr.) — Please speak a little slower.
跟着录音大声读出来。(Gēnzhe lùyīn dàshēng dú chūlái.) — Read aloud following the recording.
每天练习写五个生字。(Měitiān liànxí xiě wǔ gè shēngzì.) — Practice writing five new characters each day.
我每天早上七点起床。(Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.) — I get up at 7 AM every day.

words.English Meaning: to sleep / to go to bed
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 时间不早了，快去睡觉吧。(Shíjiān bù zǎo le, kuài qù shuìjiào ba.) — It's getting late, hurry and go to bed.

words.English Meaning: to take a bath / to shower
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 晚上我想洗澡，然后再睡觉。(Wǎnshang wǒ xiǎng xǐzǎo, ránhòu zài shuìjiào.) — In the evening I want to take a shower, then go to sleep.
周末我们一起去图书馆吧。(Zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn ba.) — Let's go to the library together this weekend.
欢迎你来我家做客。(Huānyíng nǐ lái wǒ jiā zuòkè.) — Welcome to come over to my house as a guest.
天黑了，我们回家吧。(Tiān hēi le, wǒmen huí jiā ba.) — It's dark, let's go back home.
我的房间非常干净整洁。(Wǒ de fángjiān fēicháng gānjìng zhěngjié.) — My room is very clean and tidy.
出门前请把门关好。(Chū mén qián qǐng bǎ mén guān hǎo.) — Please close the door before going out.
请打开窗户通通风。(Qǐng dǎkāi chuānghu tōngtōng fēng.) — Please open the window for fresh air.
桌子上有一台笔记本电脑。(Zhuōzi shang yǒu yì tái bǐjìběn diànnǎo.) — There is a laptop on the desk.
这把木椅子坐着很舒服。(Zhè bǎ mù yǐzi zuò zhe hěn shūfu.) — This wooden chair is very comfortable to sit on.
我的手机快没电了。(Wǒ de shǒujī kuài méi diàn le.) — My phone is running out of battery.
我在电脑上查阅资料。(Wǒ zài diànnǎo shang cháyuè zīliào.) — I look up materials on the computer.
爸爸正在看中文新闻电视节目。(Bàba zhèngzài kàn zhōngwén xīnwén diànshì jiémù.) — Dad is watching a Chinese TV news program.
我喜欢在图书馆看书。(Wǒ xǐhuan zài túshūguǎn kàn shū.) — I like reading books in the library.
今天很冷，多穿点衣服。(Jīntiān hěn lěng, duō chuān diǎn yīfu.) — It's very cold today, put on more clothes.
饭前一定要洗手。(Fàn qián yídìng yào xǐshǒu.) — Always wash your hands before eating.
周末我喜欢在家做饭。(Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuan zài jiā zuòfàn.) — I like cooking at home on weekends.

words.English Meaning: to rest / to take a break
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 工作累了就休息十分钟。(Gōngzuò lèi le jiù xiūxi shí fēnzhōng.) — Take a 10-minute break when you are tired from work.
我晚上给你打电话。(Wǒ wǎnshang gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.) — I will give you a call tonight.
